reference.title: Amiga ROM Kernel Reference Manual: DOS, section 14.8.3
claims: ACTION_DISK_INFO is action 25 and takes a BPTR to InfoData.
For a graphical console, InfoData.id_VolumeNode returns a pointer to the intuition Window; non-window consoles leave it NULL.

observations.operation: DoPkt on Process.ConsoleTask with ACTION_DISK_INFO (25); D3 is the stack InfoData address shifted right by two, and D4-D7 are zero.
load the raw long at InfoData+0x1c (id_VolumeNode) as the console Window pointer
if id_VolumeNode is NULL, set success result and zero IoErr, then clean up without changing a font or writing output
pass Window+0x32 (Window.RastPort) and the opened font to graphics.library/SetFont
read the prior font at Window+0x80, close it if non-null, then store the opened font at the same field

layout_evidence.source: DOS InfoData and Intuition Window public structure layouts in the CopperSharp SDK; offsets agree with the HUNK accesses

conclusion: The original uses ACTION_DISK_INFO to obtain a graphical console Window, treats id_VolumeNode as a raw Window pointer, changes that Window's RastPort font, and updates Window.Font. A NULL Window is a successful no-op. The DoPkt D0 result is not tested.
evidence_limits: Static binary and public documentation evidence do not establish behavior of the specific Workbench 3.1 console handler on a guest.
InfoData.id_VolumeNode is normally typed BPTR, while this command treats the console-specific returned value as a raw APTR; this is recorded from the binary and needs guest confirmation.
This audit does not establish console resource lifetime, PURE/resident lifecycle, licensing, package admission or shipping equivalence.
